model_name: Synthetic Credit Approval Logistic Regression Model
intended_use: Classroom prototype for jurisdiction-aware RegTech compliance monitoring in credit scoring / algorithmic fairness.
not_intended_for: Full replacement of human compliance judgement
assumptions: Synthetic data is used because real bank credit data is unavailable.
Protected attributes are excluded from model training but retained for fairness auditing.
Different jurisdictions can require different reporting and governance outputs.

failure_modes.example: EU portfolio is checked using US-only report settings.
failure_modes.mitigation: Use validated jurisdiction codes and require compliance-owner approval.

failure_modes.example: Applicant population changes and approval disparity increases.
failure_modes.mitigation: Schedule periodic drift monitoring and retraining review.

failure_modes.example: Regulatory threshold or documentation requirement changes during a reporting cycle.
failure_modes.mitigation: Version the rules engine and store the rule version used for each report.

failure_modes.example: Reason codes are treated as causal explanations.
failure_modes.mitigation: Label explanations as model-based approximations and require human review.
